comment: The COM, ALL and step jacks carry whatever is patched through the switch, audio or CV, so they have no family. The ALL and COM positions each hold both an input and an output index, only one of which is live at a time, and both are tagged. The maker's own notes suggest chaining Muxlicers by patching one EOC output into the next module's one-shot/reset input, with both clocked from the same source.
